result.noFurtherDiscriminator: All six turn windows have been observed; the trajectory is fully exhausted. The core was successfully recovered and cooling repaired, ruling out information-route-bottleneck and world-mechanic-affordance as the primary blocker. The decisive causal factor is sustained hostile/environmental pressure (Raider Holt's repeated scatter-blast on the exposed medic plus reactor-instability drain) collapsing team health and killing Medic Reyes before the recovered core could be extracted. No unobserved turn remains that could change this bounded target.
result.rationale: The intended probe was "accept higher tactical exposure to recover the Research Core." The trajectory shows the Agent successfully reached the Research Core (Engineer Imani picked it up at turn 2, reactor-console) and even repaired the cooling system to full integrity (0.58→1.0 by turn 5). The core objective was NOT blocked by lack of information (orbital-scan revealed reactor-console, reactor, cooling, reactor-instability, and ground:research-core at turn 0), nor by a missing world mechanic (the pickup and repair affordances both worked and were exploited). The decisive failure is survival/spatial pressure: the aggressive split formation exposed Medic Reyes to repeated scatter-blast attacks from Raider Holt (25 dmg at turns 2, 3, 4, 5), driving her from 90→65→40→15→0 (dead by turn 5), while the reactor-instability hazard drained 10 HP/turn from everyone in the reactor zones (Imani 100→60, Chen 110→70) and reactor-heat climbed to 100. The mandatory "rescue-team-survives" objective is now failed (Medic Reyes dead), and the team's health is collapsing faster than the core can be extracted. The bottleneck is hostile/environmental pressure (Raider Holt's sustained fire on the exposed medic, plus reactor hazard) blocking the team before the recovered core can be converted into a completed objective. This is not a local-policy-choice failure (the Agent did exploit the available pickup and repair affordances) and not a world-mechanic-affordance failure (the affordances were present and functional).
